limitations: Only three single-reference proxy contour selections. Eight fixed-yaw camera/pose fits across three selected models (3+3+2) reuse the same three source images and do not count as independent views. Apollo pair different unofficial designs and variant mismatch; both hit yaw boundary. Gallowglas two diagnostic references, clipped proxy and illustration. Other cropped, rear or variant-mismatched references retained. Manual approximate outer silhouette from visible thumbnails, not full component masks or optical calibration. Partial arm fit using forearm lower armor bounds where annotated; no Godot validation. Initial larger search timed out, then bounded runner completed. All final exact patches replayed and all sampled axial points remain clear.
